title: touch screens on several displays go to their own display

clauses.text: a touch on an external touch screen or digitizer lands on that display, not on the built-in screen

steps.do: With the built-in screen and one external display connected, touch the external display near its top left corner.
steps.expect: The pointer appears on the external display where the finger touched, not on the built-in screen.

steps.do: Open Settings, Displays and press t (Touch screen) and then d (Next touch screen).
steps.expect: The choice of touch screen moves to the next one and the touch is then mapped to the display shown for it.

clauses.text: with several external displays the touch calibration asks one display at a time, and Esc skips

steps.do: Connect two external displays and a touch screen that the computer cannot place by itself. In Settings, Displays press c (Touch calibration).
steps.expect: The screen asks you to touch the highlighted display, one display at a time.

steps.do: Touch each highlighted display, then start again and press Esc at the first step.
steps.expect: Each touch is placed on the display that was highlighted, and Esc skips the step without changing the mapping.
